name: Avinish Kumar Tripathi
comment: What I really love about Temple Girl Kids is how it makes our traditional stories interesting and accessible for children. The stories of Rama, Hanuman and our culture are presented in such a beautiful way that kids can learn values while simply enjoying the stories. I especially like that it encourages listening instead of keeping children glued to a screen. A beautiful initiative by Namratha ji! ❤️🙏

name: Mamathaatla
comment: Temple Girl journey is truly inspiring. Kids are becoming happier, more disciplined, and learning good values through the activities and teachings. As parents, we are also very happy and satisfied to see such positive changes in our children. The efforts put into guiding children on the right path are commendable. Thank you for creating such a wonderful platform that brings joy, culture, and meaningful learning to families. Mam a small concern not only English keep in other languages also mam

name: Kumar Shiva
comment: This app is an absolute treasure for families! The incredible adventures of Rama and Hanuman are told with so much heart and excitement. It transforms the grand stories of the Puranas into captivating bedtime tales that keep my kids eager to learn more. It is educational, beautifully crafted, and a perfect five-star experience!

name: yashwith uchil
comment: Temple Girl Kids is perfect for children who love stories. The best part is that kids can simply listen without constantly watching the screen, making it great for bedtime, travel, or quiet time. Meaningful stories, positive values, and less screen time — a wonderful choice for parents and children alike. 💗✨

name: Pavani Pradithi
comment: so happy to see this app it is definitely good idea to showcase our historical stories as bed time Stories for our kids it is a very good opportunity for kids 😀 I will say that everyone should download this and watch all .
